title: Plan a threshold run for Thursday

turns.question: Plan a threshold run for Thursday. I want to get under 45 min for the 10K.
turns.answer:
Your recovery is good for it. HRV is **68 ms**, inside your normal range, and your training load is *productive* at 412.

Your last three 5K efforts averaged **4:28 /km**. A 44:30 10K needs about **4:27 /km**, so you are close.

## Thursday: 4 × 6 min at threshold

- 15 min easy warm-up in zone 2
- 4 × 6 min in zone 4, with 2 min easy jog between
- 10 min cool-down

Keep the reps at **4:15 to 4:20 /km**. If your heart rate goes over 172 in the last rep, stop there. I saved the workout to Garmin, so it is on your watch for Thursday.
